notes: ADIAC search metadata for an item dated 19 February says SOPECO workers demanded government payment of 24 months of arrears on 15–16 February. Its direct story body and a direct article URL were not recovered; two web.open attempts on the item returned Cache miss. A later same-publisher listing retrieval is retained as an access incident only: its receipt inputs had changed before the request, so its target-not-found result is not evidence of absence. The search snippet does not establish whether workers assembled publicly, struck, held a sit-in, or made another demand; the 15–16 dates cannot yet be coded as physical event dates. Amnesty separately says 280 staff were still claiming 17 months of arrears in February; 280 is not turnout, and its references to a 2019 sit-in and a September 2020 strike do not establish February continuity. June 2020 and May 2021 SOPECO actions are separately excluded. An ACI search-result title is retained as a separate pending historical lead, but its date, occurrence and body claims are unknown/quarantined and it is not evidence for this candidate. Country identity remains Republic of the Congo/Brazzaville, provisional ccode 484; do not merge with DRC/Kinshasa results.
open_questions: Can the direct ADIAC February story be recovered or independently verified, and what physical action, if any, took place on 15–16 February?
Was the claimed action public/open, and where exactly did it occur?
How many people participated; is there evidence of 50 or more? Do not use the 280-staff arrears figure as turnout.
Who organized the action, and what was the precise demand and target (government, SOPECO management, or both)?
What were the physical start/end dates, and is there evidence of uninterrupted continuity from an earlier action?
Were protesters violent, and what event-specific accommodation, arrests, beatings, dispersal, ignoring, killings or shootings occurred?

Can the separate ACI search-result title be dated and tied to an independently verified episode from a source with a valid per-attempt access record? Treat the retained X003 row as non-operative until date and occurrence are established; do not use quarantined page-open output.
What date and episode does the Africa Press search-only SOPECO management lead describe? The publisher-wide hold rules out body and same-story-copy requests.
